red_flags.label: Claims to be police / CBI / bank / government
Tells the victim to keep it secret
Asks to move money to a 'safe account'

fact: Police, CBI, ED and customs never arrest anyone over a video call and never ask you to move money to a 'safe account'. 'Digital arrest' does not exist in Indian law.
dadi_reply: Arre wah, digital arrest! Main toh bas daal ka paani ubaal rahi hoon. Rathore... naam likhne ke liye thoda zor se boliye, chashma nahi mila.
